decisions.summary: Treat the existing `.gpd` workspace as a live project and re-scope in place instead of rerunning project bootstrap.
Make contradiction resolution and comparator freeze the current gate; later wedge or branch work stays subordinate.
Preserve the structured-tier-only qualifier and the active `LicenseRef-Zer0pa-SAL-6.0` surface as hard constraints.
Use the local M1 lane first; Red Magic only when attached and RunPod only after explicit user approval.
Treat frozen engineering-comparator results as sovereign against any broader “commercially disruptive compression” language; `brotli` currently beats `zpe_ink` on the structured tier.
Use RunPod direct TCP as the authoritative Phase 03 external host because the pod alias path is not currently key-valid.
Treat Calliar as the strongest honest non-Latin online-stroke surface currently available in-lane.
Treat blind-clone core success as valuable but insufficient for a release `GO`.
Keep the primitive-token runtime candidate-only even after its structured-tier `brotli` win, because bounded Calliar fidelity collapses.
Treat the tokenizer scaffold as shipped evidence of branch viability, not as wedge or release closure.
Treat the 2026-04-05 action brief as candidate input rather than contract override when it conflicts with the live repo state.
Close Phase 05 with a final `NO-GO`: no current wedge is proven; interoperability is only a future candidate lane on a stabilized repo state.
